doc.title: 数据库性能测试:实例教程与优化策略
doc.text: 1. 数据库性能测试的定义与目标 在当今信息化时代,数据是企业最为宝贵的资产之一。为了保证数据的可靠性和稳定性,数据库性能测试成为不可或缺的一环。数据库性能测试的定义是通过一系列科学合理的方法对数据库系统的响应时间、吞吐量、资源消耗等性能指标进行测试和验证的过程。它的主要目标是确保数据库系统能够满足业务需求,在高负载情况下保持稳定和快速的响应。 在进行性能测试前,首先要明确测试目标,它通常涉及以下方面: 响应时间(Response Time):用户发起操作到系统完成响应的时间。这个时间越短越好,可以提升用户体验。 吞吐量(Throughput):在单位时间内可以处理的事务数量。高吞吐量意味着系统能够在较短的时间内处理更多的请求。 资源使用率(Resource Utilization):系统中CPU、内存、磁盘和网络等资源的使用情况。合理的资源使用可以降低运营成本并保证系统稳定运行。 接下来的章节将详细探讨如何制定性能测试计划、选择性能指标、选择与使用性能测试工具、分析性能瓶颈、数据库配置调整、数据表分区与分片策略,以及监控与调优方法,从而帮助读者全面掌握数据库性能测试的知识。 2. 性能测试计划的制定与指标选择 2.1 性能测试计划的制定 2.1.1测试环境的搭建 在性能测试计划制定的第一步是搭建一个准确的测试环境。这个环境需要尽可能的模拟真实生产环境,包括硬件配置、软件版本、网络条件等。这是为了保证测试结果的真实性和可靠性。例如,如果我们的目标是测试MySQL数据库的性能,我们需要确保测试环境中的MySQL版本、操作系统以及硬件资源(CPU、内存、存储)与生产环境一致。 搭建测试环境时需要关注以下几点: -硬件资源配比:确保测试环境的硬件资源(CPU、内存、存储)与生产环境保持一致,或者根据需要进行适当的缩放。 -软件版本:操作系统、数据库管理系统以及所有相关的中间件和应用程序必须与生产环境一致。

doc.title: mysql querytimeout – 站长手册
doc.text:
mysql querytimeout
MySQL Query Timeout是指在MySQL查询执行的过程中，如果查询时间超过了一定时限，系统会强制结束该查询操作以避免系统响应过慢的问题。在实际业务场景中，这种情况比较少见，但在某些极端情况下会发生。
为了避免这种情况，MySQL提供了一种机制，即Query Timeout。在查询过程中，如果超过了数据库设置的超时时间，MySQL会自动中止该查询，以保证系统能够正常地运行。
在MySQL中，查询时间可以通过以下两种方式来控制：
   
SET @SESSION.wait_timeout = 30; / 设置会话的timeout时间
SET @GLOBAL.connect_timeout = 60; / 设置全局timeout时间
   
其中，wait_timeout通常用于控制查询执行的时间，如果查询时间超过设置的wait_timeout时间，系统就会杀掉该查询。connect_timeout用于控制建立连接的时间，如果建立连接的时间超过了设置的connect_timeout时间，系统也会失败。
此外，MySQL还提供了一些其他的控制查询时间的参数，比如：
   
interactive_timeout
net_read_timeout
net_write_timeout
   
这些参数会根据用户的不同操作而发生变化。比如，在交互式操作中，系统通常会使用interactive_timeout参数来控制查询的最大时间。在读取和写入数据时，系统会使用net_read_timeout和net_write_timeout参数来控制读取和写入数据的最大时间。
综上所述，MySQL Query Timeout是一种非常实用的机制，可以让系统在遇到查询耗时过长的情况时，自动中止该查询操作，以保证系统响应的及时性和稳定性。

doc.title: 生物基原料制备可持续航空燃料的技术路线探索
doc.text:
在全球航空业“减碳压力”不断加大的背景下，可持续航空燃料（SAF）的研发和产业化成为焦点。与化石资源相比，生物基原料（包括餐厨废油为代表的城市有机废弃物、农林废弃物等）不仅来源广泛、可再生性强，还能有效降低航空燃料碳排放。据中国产业发展促进会生物质能产业分会统计，我国每年产生的生物质资源总量约35亿吨，具有巨大的能源化潜力。当前，基于餐厨废油的酯和脂肪酸类加氢（HEFA）工艺已成为我国生物航煤生产的主流技术路线，产能规模已突破100万吨；但由于国内餐厨废油年可收集量仅约500万吨，客观上限制了该工艺的产能提升空间，因此，推进HEFA工艺的提质增效是突破当前该技术发展瓶颈的必要举措。此外，以秸秆为代表的农林废弃物主要通过直接还田等低附加值方式利用，尚未构建起高附加值的能源产品体系；若能推动农林废弃物制取SAF的产业化应用，不仅可显著提升SAF产能，还能有效降低对化石燃料的依赖，为我国实现“双碳”战略目标提供重要支撑。
2025年8月20日至21日由中国民用航空第二研究所主办、民航二所可持续航空燃料发展研究中心承办的首届“可持续航空燃料科技创新和产业发展技术交流会暨产业联盟成立大会”上，国内众多SAF生产企业、科研院所和高校重点介绍了生物质基SAF的生产工艺和催化剂研究的最新进展，为后续我国SAF行业发展指引方向。
大会分享的生物质基SAF的研究与产业化主要集中在三条技术路线：生物质气化–费托合成（G+FT）技术、生物质快速热解–加氢脱氧技术以及HEFA技术。G+FT依托合成气平台，技术成熟度较高；生物质快速热解–加氢脱氧技术则依托炼油工艺，实现与现有产业的耦合；HEFA技术成熟，产业化程度高，催化剂和工艺还可进一步优化。
（一）生物质气化–费托合成（G+FT）路线
G+FT路线通过将生物质经高温气化转化为合成气（CO+H2），再通过费托合成反应制备长链烃，最终经加氢裂化、异构化等工序得到符合航空燃料标准的馏分。这一路线最大的优势在于灵活性：无论原料是秸秆、木屑，还是城市固废，均可通过气化工艺转化为合成气，实现多元原料到标准燃料的“统一接口”。然而，要实现高效稳定的气化并非易事。生物质具有高挥发分、低密度、高杂质含量等特征，在气化过程中容易产生焦油、焦炭和复杂的副产物，不仅影响气化效率，还会导致设备腐蚀等问题。因此，如何稳定获得低焦油、高品质的合成气，是G+FT路线的核心难题。
1.生物质气化
（1）固定床气化技术
清华大学赵明教授团队提出了“双氧化层顺逆流耦合”的固定床气化技术。该技术通过优化气流场与氧化层分布，使大部分焦油在炉内被有效转化为可利用气体，从根源上解决了焦油难题。实验数据显示，产物气中CO+H2体积分数可达75%，碳转化率高达98.97%。团队研发的“允清炉”已实现工程化应用，能够为后续费托合成提供品质稳定的原料气。相比传统固定床，其在焦油控制与能效方面均有明显优势。
图1 生物质空气气化工艺
（2）气流床气化
华东理工大学李伟峰教授团队将煤气化成熟的气流床技术引入生物质领域，开发了低温干燥制粉的新工艺，突破了大颗粒输送与反应难题。通过“先干燥制粉，再气化”的模式，避免了高能耗的烘焙碳化过程，实现了高效率、低能耗的转化。该技术的预处理成本低至70元/吨，气化转化率达到99%，合成气中甲烷杂质浓度低于500ppm，完全满足下游化工需求。目前已成功应用于岚泽30万吨绿色甲醇项目，未来可转移到SAF制备领域。此外，技术团队创新研发了集成生物质发酵+浆料气化的生物质浆态气流床气化技术，直接利用乙醇发酵产生的稳定木质素浆料，省去制浆/制粉系统，降低了投资、原料预处理和运行成本。
（3）鼓泡流化床
上海泽镨工程科技有限公司开发了加压鼓泡流化床气化技术。与固定床、气流床相比，该技术在温度控制、气固接触效率和原料适应性上更具优势。通过纯氧气化，不仅可获得不含焦油、废水少的合成气，还能在废锅流程副产4.0 MPag高压蒸汽，碳转化率达到98%。原料适应性广且预处理简单，总投资低。目前，该公司正在河南建设以玉米秸秆为原料的示范装置，计划将气化得到的合成气用于绿色甲醇和SAF的生产。这标志着鼓泡流化床生物质气化技术从实验室研究走向了实质性的产业化阶段。
2.费托合成
气化所产合成气经费托合成制备符合标准的航空燃料，该过程高度依赖催化剂的选择性与稳定性，是决定燃料分布与品质的关键环节。中科院山西煤炭化学研究所的贾丽涛研究员团队，在Co基固定床费托合成与重质蜡裂化/异构化方面有着深厚积累。通过调控催化剂载体、暴露晶面等因素，该研究团队提高了Co基催化剂的反应效果，C5+时空收率提高100%，C5+选择性提高3-5%，单塔产能提高100%，前期已建成5万吨/年Co基固定床技术制费托蜡的工业示范装置，可通过工艺参数调整快速实现向SAF制备技术的转型，大幅缩短技术落地周期。
图2 生物质原料经G+FT制SAF路线图
重庆岚泽能源科技有限公司则聚焦全链条一体化，开发了从生物质气化到费托合成技术的全流程工艺。基于CoMn负载的双功能催化剂在小试费托反应中表现出良好的稳定性（大于2000小时），并成功实现催化剂放大制备，应用于千吨级费托合成SAF中试装置。中试验证中CO总转化率高达90%，航煤馏分选择性高于60%，已通过中国石油和化学工业联合会72小时现场鉴定。
(二）生物质快速热解–加氢脱氧路线
与G+FT不同，热解–加氢脱氧路线强调与现有炼油工艺的结合。其基本思路是将生物质经快速热解转化为生物油，再通过加氢脱氧工艺去除其中的氧原子，得到碳氢比与传统航煤接近的馏分。然而生物油通常含水量高（20–30%）、酸性强、黏度大，直接使用存在诸多问题。同时，催化剂在加氢脱氧过程中易结焦失活，成为限制工业化的关键瓶颈。
图3 生物质快速热解+加氢脱氧制SAF技术路线
针对上述问题，四川大学碳中和未来技术学院的江霞教授分享了低能耗生物质快速热解-加氢脱氧制航煤的研究。该技术旨在利用现有炼油厂的石油加氢工艺，实现热解油提质与石油炼制产业的“共炼”。针对秸秆热解能耗高、催化剂易结焦等问题，该团队提出了低能耗的秸秆非相变干燥技术，并开发了高强度抗水炭球催化剂，以应对热解液含水、高酸、黏度大等特性。目前，已建成吨级成套装置，生物燃料收率达18%。
（三）新型HEFA技术路线
与其他固体生物质相比，餐厨废油组成更接近传统油品，炼制工艺与化石基燃料相似，因此在SAF制备中具备工艺简单与快速落地的优势。目前，HEFA 路线已实现商业化，是全球唯一大规模实现SAF生产的工艺。但传统HEFA工艺存在氢耗高和芳烃不足等问题。
图4 HEFA传统工艺与无氢脱羰新工艺对比
对此，华东师范大学赵晨教授团队提出了“无氢脱羰”新工艺。该方法通过载体对酸/酯的特定锚定作用，并利用长链烯烃中间体的脱氢–环化–芳构化反应，在无氢条件下直接脱氧并生成长链烷基芳烃。目前已在小试阶段成功合成生物航煤，并通过了48项性能测试，下一步将向千吨级中试推进。该创新不仅降低了油脂脱氧过程中的氢耗，还弥补了传统HEFA产品在芳烃组分上的不足，更契合航空燃料的需求。
（四）总结与展望
从整体来看，生物基原料制备SAF正在形成“多路径并行”的技术格局。生物质G+FT路线展现了通过全新工艺链实现规模化燃料生产的潜力，且对原料适应性强，是应对未来全球民航绿色脱碳主要路线之一；快速热解–加氢脱氧则强调与现有炼油体系的协同，能够在较低投资门槛下实现产业化；而基于无氢脱羰技术的新型HEFA工艺，有望解决目前传统路线氢耗高、化学组成单一的问题，进一步提升HEFA技术的竞争力。三者各有侧重，却都指向同一个目标——将分散、低价值的生物基原料转化为高附加值的绿色航空燃料。
科研界和产业界正基于不同生物质原料的特性，差异化开发SAF制备工艺，并集中攻克核心技术瓶颈：从生物质气化过程中的焦油控制，到催化剂的高效与长寿命运行，再到废弃油脂的高值化利用，均取得了突破性进展。这些探索不仅有助于减少对化石燃料的依赖，更通过统筹碳循环、能源安全与环境保护，实现三者的协同发展。
展望未来，随着“双碳”战略的深入实施和碳市场机制的完善，生物基SAF将在我国迎来更大规模的应用。无论是田间地头的秸秆，还是餐桌后的废弃油脂，亦或城市有机垃圾，都有望被重新激活，进入绿色能源循环。可以预见，在未来我国的蓝天之上将会有越来越多航班由这些生物基原料驱动，真正实现从废弃物到SAF的绿色转型。

doc.title: 氢能/电动/生物燃料！航空发动机低碳革命全景图 | 中飞院刘翔团队：新能源航空发动机研究进展与展望
doc.text: 坚持学术贴近工程依靠专家服务读者新能源航空发动机研究进展与展望文章亮点：近年来，我国经济持续增长，对清洁能源的需求日益迫切。航空业也一直在积极探索清洁、低排放的能源技术，使用新燃料和新能源的新型航空发动机被认为是减少碳排放的重要解决方案。本文介绍了新能源航空发动机的研究进展，首先按照时间顺序介绍了航空发动机的发展历程，然后介绍了新燃料航空发动机、电动飞机、燃料电池航空发动机等的研究现状，最后对新能源航空发动机未来的研究方向进行了展望。研究背景：航空发动机是一种用于提供推力、驱动飞机飞行的发动机，是飞机最关键的组件之一。航空发动机通常基于内燃机机制运行，通过燃烧燃料以产生高温高压的气体，并将这些气体转换成推力以驱动飞机向前飞行。根据不同的工作原理，航空发动机可以分为多种类型，包括涡轮喷气发动机、涡桨发动机和活塞发动机等。目前，传统的航空发动机正在向核能动力、太阳能动力、燃料电池动力以及新能源燃料航空发动机发展。现如今，社会发展最核心的主题之一是日益增长的能源需求。在污染和温室效应等环境问题下，新能源逐渐成为应对能源危机和环境污染这一全球挑战的重要战略。随着人们对环境的关注和日益严格的环境法规，减少与航空公司运营相关的环境危害仍然是航空业的首要问题。实现无碳排放经济是当前我国所追求的一个目标。科学和技术进步需要遵循这一发展趋势，在提高热机效率的同时，减少碳和其他有害气体的排放，降低对大气的污染和温室效应的影响。将航空业与化石燃料分离是迈向环保的有效措施之一。因此，需要找到合适的替代传统化石燃料的能量方法。在这种情况下，新能源燃料似乎是一种可能的解决方案。本文对新能源航空发动机进行综述，介绍近年来燃料电池航空发动机、新燃料航空发动机及其他新能源航空发动机的研究现状，并对未来新能源航空发动机的研究和发展进行展望。总结与展望：为消减、根治日益恶化的全球温室效应问题，联合国制定了碳减排的全球经济社会发展战略。民航活动碳排放现占全球碳排放总量约2%，预计2050将占全球碳排放总量的25%。为此，全电飞行器成为世界各国民航发展碳减排的基本路径。全电飞行器技术是一项跨时代的高新技术，大力发展全电飞行器是解决能源与环境问题的有效途径。全电航空从净零排放、高效节能、智能互联的理念出发，优化飞行器的推进系统、控制系统、整体结构等性能，采用电能、氢能等全电取代传统化石能源，改变传统飞行器设计思想，是未来航空产业的发展方向。因此，全面发展新能源航空发动机，必将大幅提高我国全电飞行器的质量，并能对环境保护做出贡献，提高我国全电航空产业的自给能力和核心竞争力，实现对国外企业的“弯道超车”，快速占领产业价值链的高端。1） 太阳能无人机、核能航空发动机发展时间较短且相关技术不够成熟；各类电动飞机目前也仅能满足电动飞机的最低使用要求，未来发展也面临很多技术挑战；燃料电池具有诸多环境优势且效率远高于传统航空发动机，未来燃料电池有望取代飞机上的多个发电系统；以氢燃料、液化天然气燃料为代表的新燃料航空发动机是极具前景的航空发动机技术，但也具有成本高等问题；生物航空燃料代表的是可持续航空燃料的一种，在未来一段时间内，可持续航空燃料的大规模应用将成为航空业减少二氧化碳排放的主要驱动力，可持续航空燃料将成为替代传统航空燃油的首选。2） 国家相关政策及发展纲要均表明，在未来一段时间内，大型飞机将综合运用新型气动布局、可持续航空燃料和混合动力等多种技术路径。同时，还将积极探索氢能源、液化天然气等技术路线，以进行前瞻性布局，促进未来产业的发展。目标是到2025年使用可持续航空燃料发动机的国产民用飞机要实现示范应用，到2035年新能源航空器成为发展主流。3） 目前，全球的能源消费正朝着低碳化和无碳化的方向发展。研发对环境友好和经济性比较好的航空燃料是新能源航空发动机技术的目标。发展新能源航空发动机，对我国能源、交通、国防等方面的原创性科学技术具有重要意义，并且能够促进我国“双碳”战略的实施。随着科技的不断进步，新能源发动机技术也在不断创新，例如，燃料电池的效率改进、氢燃料技术等都在持续改进，以提高新能源发动机的效率、续航里程和可靠性。随着人们环保意识的提高和对气候变化的关注，推动了新能源发动机市场的增长。新能源发动机的发展趋势是朝着更高效、更清洁、更可持续的方向发展，随着技术创新、市场需求和政策支持的不断推动，预计新能源发动机在未来将逐渐取代传统燃油发动机，成为主流的动力来源之一。引用格式：刘翔, 竺宏杰, 张爱聆, 等. 新能源航空发动机研究进展与展望[J]. 航空工程进展, 2025, 16(3): 17-28. doc.title: 为何今年失业率那么高？普通人真的越来越难了吗？
doc.text:
究竟是何缘由催生了这番困局？今日，我们深入剖析五大症结所在。
第一，当全球经济步入衰退或萧条的深渊，中国亦无法独善其身。此刻，企业利润缩水，投资热情骤降，为求生存，纷纷祭出裁员利剑，以削减成本。劳动力市场瞬间供过于求，失业率随之飙升，职场人惶惶不安。
经济寒冬之下，房地产市场雪崩，楼盘滞销，房价滑坡，民众资产大幅缩水，消费信心遭受重创。加之人口负增长趋势加剧，年轻人口锐减，城镇化进程几近饱和，全社会购买力陷入低迷。商品滞销，商家变现乏力，发薪难以为继，非但不敢招兵买马，反而频频裁员以求自保。由此，失业率节节攀高，民众收入锐减，消费能力持续萎缩，形成恶性循环。
中国大学生失业率是青年整体失业率的1.4倍，是青年失业人口的主体，失业率在28%左右，已超过韩国。
官方统计青年失业率高达20%的情况下，年轻人其实很多时候也很为难。
当下的环境，我们正在面临经济危机，房地产衰竭，以及产业结构调整。
尤其是今年，失业率达到20.8%，这是统计局在6月公布的5月青年失业率，这一数据从今年1月以来持续上涨，如今达到了2018年公布青年失业率以来的最高值。
单纯从个人感受上来说，今年的广州人多了很多人，相比以往，地铁早早就已经开始了限流。
而就业的问题不仅仅是经济的问题，也是社会稳定的问题。
更为可怕的是，某些低智砖家的惊人语录：“低收入者应该把空闲房子出租，私家车拉客增收入。”“房价高是因为老百姓手里钱太多了。”“自行车是导致空气污染的最大原因。”“适当惩罚不生孩子的年轻人。”“中国家庭平均总资产300万很正常，现在谁家没个50万现金？”……
第二，外部环境恶化，发达国家需求疲软，美国的打压，高科技产业步履维艰，新增就业岗位寥寥。中美脱钩的背景下，国际资本对华投资热情骤降，外资企业撤离或缩减业务，供应链纷纷迁徙至东南亚，工作岗位如沙漏般悄然流失。我国外贸业在风雨中摇摆，压力传导至就业市场，尤其对年轻人就业前景蒙上一层阴影。
第三，科技创新引擎动力不足，技术单位、事业单位、研究机构与高校在近年内鲜有重大突破。在全球技术脱钩的大潮中，我们失去发达国家的技术助力，同时面临其严厉的技术封锁。科研体系试图以行政化手段快速追赶，然而成效难言乐观，即便是基于现有技术的产品商业化进程亦步履维艰，二次创新之路荆棘遍布。
科技洪流滚滚向前，传统行业与岗位渐次消逝，而新兴领域与职位尚未充分孕育并吸纳充裕劳动力。自动化与人工智能的崛起，使得无数简单劳动岗位被机器无情取代。
第四，教育产业化浪潮裹挟下，大批身处中间地带的年轻学子处境尴尬。他们搭乘大学扩招的顺风车，耗尽家庭储蓄，懵懂步入象牙塔，却在教育资源分配不均的现实中收获寥寥。尤其是二三本院校的毕业生，高不成、低不就，技能与市场需求错配，成为结构性失业的典型代表。
第五，每年千万毕业生如潮涌出，涌入就业市场，供需矛盾凸显。教育体制未能精准对接市场需求，致使众多毕业生手持贬值的学历证书，面临毕业即失业的窘境。他们渴望体面就业，却难以放下身段从事蓝领工作，学历与现实间的巨大落差，如同一道难以逾越的鸿沟。
失业率攀升的背后，交织着经济周期的无情鞭挞、消费市场的萎靡不振、外贸领域的逆风航行、技术创新的迟滞以及教育产业化的泡沫效应。这些复杂因素相互交织，共同构成了当前就业市场的严峻图景。
促进经济发展是解决失业问题的重要途径。通过发展产业、创造就业机会，提高经济增长速度，可以为更多的人提供工作岗位。
政府可以通过制定有利于企业发展和生产的政策，为企业提供支持和激励，鼓励他们扩大生产规模和创造更多的就业机会。
此外，政府还可以加大对创业者和自主就业人群的支持力度，提供贷款、补贴和培训等帮助，鼓励他们开展自主创业，促进就业增长。
②
加强职业培训和教育是解决失业问题的重要手段。
在现代社会，科技发展迅猛，职业需求也在不断变化。因此，提供职业培训和提高员工技能水平是关键。
政府可以与教育机构、职业培训中心和企业合作，共同推动职业技能培训的普及。
此外，还可以通过设立专门的就业服务机构，帮助求职者进行职业规划、提供就业技巧和帮助他们找到适合自己的工作岗位。

doc.title: 就业·刨业·失业
doc.text:
失业是一个复杂的社会经济现象，其背后涉及多种因素的综合作用。以下是对失业因素的一些分析：
一、宏观经济因素
经济增长放缓：经济增长的放缓会导致企业生产活动减少，进而减少对劳动力的需求，这是导致失业率上升的重要原因之一。
经济结构调整：随着经济的发展，一些传统产业可能会衰退，而新兴产业的发展需要时间来吸收劳动力。这个过程中可能会出现结构性失业，即劳动者的技能与市场需求不匹配，导致一部分人失业。
二、行业与企业因素
企业破产与裁员：企业因经营不善、市场竞争等原因导致破产，或者为降低成本、优化结构等进行裁员，都会使员工失业。
合同期满不续签：劳动合同到期后，雇主选择不续签，员工因此失业。
三、个人因素
职业规划不当：一些人由于职业规划不当，选择的工作领域或岗位与自身能力不匹配，导致在就业市场上缺乏竞争力，最终可能失业。
技能不匹配：随着技术的发展和产业升级，一些低技能、重复性高的工作岗位被机器替代，而新兴行业对人才的需求又呈现出新的特点。许多劳动者由于技能不匹配或缺乏必要的培训，难以适应这种变化，从而陷入失业的困境。
健康问题：因个人健康原因无法继续工作而失业的情况也时有发生。
家庭原因：如因家庭突发情况需要全职照顾家人而不得不离职。
四、政策与社会因素
政策变动：政府的宏观经济政策、就业政策、教育政策等都会对就业市场产生影响。政策的不确定性和变动可能会导致企业和劳动者的预期发生变化，从而影响就业状况。
社会保障体系：社会保障体系的不完善也可能导致失业者难以获得足够的支持来维持生活，这可能会延长他们的失业时间。
五、劳动力供需失衡
劳动力供给大于需求：在我国，由于人口基数大，每年劳动力的供给量大幅度增加，然而社会对劳动力的需求量不断减少，这样就出现了我国劳动力资源和资本资源相比过剩的矛盾，导致就业压力增大。
 失业是一个由多种因素共同作用的结果。为了降低失业率，需要政府、企业和社会各界共同努力，从促进经济增长、优化产业结构、提升劳动者技能、完善社会保障体系等多个方面入手，为劳动者创造更多的就业机会和更好的就业环境。

doc.title: 加州葡萄酒历史,加州葡萄酒历史：从起源到现代化
doc.text:
加州葡萄酒历史,加州葡萄酒历史：从起源到现代化
1. 加州葡萄酒的起源加州葡萄酒的历史可以追溯到19世纪早期，那时的加利福尼亚还是一个相对落后的农业社会。1840年代和50年代，欧洲的移民开始在加州种植葡萄，但最初的结果并不尽如人意。直到1851年，加州的葡萄酒业开始有了起色，这主要归功于三个因素。首先，移民们开始使用更好的葡萄品种；其次，他们掌握了更有效的酿酒技术；最后，美国人口的增长和经济的扩张，使得市场需求提高。2. 加州葡萄酒的发展20世纪早期，加州的葡萄酒业开始进入黄金时期。这一时期的标志性事件是1920年代的禁酒令。虽然禁酒令给葡萄酒业带来了不好的影响，但它也促使了一些酿酒师们研究如何改进酿酒技术，以避免酿造低质量的葡萄酒。1940年代至1960年代期间，加州的葡萄酒业越来越成熟，许多家庭酿酒厂也开始出现。此外，1960年代末期，葡萄酒品质进一步提高，成为葡萄酒历史上的一个重要里程碑。3. 加州葡萄酒的现代化20世纪70年代和80年代，加州的葡萄酒业进入了一个现代化的时期。酿酒师们使用了更先进的技术和设备，这些技术如今仍然是葡萄酒业的关键。在这个时期，加州的葡萄酒制造商也开始关注可持续性和环境问题。他们在采用更为环保的方法和技术方面进行了努力，并致力于发展一种更加健康和可持续的业态。4. 加州葡萄酒的未来作为世界上最大的葡萄酒生产和消费国之一，加州的葡萄酒业一直在不断发展和进步。未来，这个行业将继续面临一些挑战，包括环境保护、消费者需求的多样化以及对供应链的管理等方面。不过，加州葡萄酒业已经表明了它具有适应性和创造力，它将借助先进的技术和管理方法，在未来继续保持其领导地位。

doc.text:
11．In 1939，two brothers，Mac and Dick McDonald，started a drive-in restaurant in San Bernardino，California．They carefully chose a bus corner for their location．They had run their own businesses for years，first a theater，then a barbecue restaurant，and then another drive-in．But in their new operation，they offered a new，shortened menu：French fries，hamburgers，and sodas．To this small selection they added one new concept：quick service，no waiters or waitresses，and no tips．
Their hamburgers sold for fifteen cents．Cheese was another four cents．Their French fries and hamburgers had a remarkable uniformity （一致性），for the brothers had developed a strict routine for the preparation of their food，and they insisted on their cooks'sticking to their routine．Their new drive-in became incredibly popular，particularly for lunch．People drove up by the hundreds during the busy noontime．The self-service restaurant was so popular that the brothers had allowed ten copies of their restaurant to be opened．They were content with this modest success until they met Ray Kroc．
Kroc was a salesman who met the McDonald brothers in 1954，when he was selling milk shake-mixing machines．He quickly saw the unique appeal of the brothers'fast-food restaurants and bought the right to franchise（特许经营）other copies of their restaurants．The agreement included the right to copy the menu，the equipment，even their red and white buildings with the golden arches．
Today McDonald's is really a household name．Its names for its sandwiches have come to mean hamburger in the decades since the day Ray Kroc watched people rush up to order fifteen-cent hamburgers．In 1976，McDonald's had over $ 1billion in total sales．Its first twenty-two years is one of the most incredible success stories in modern American business history．

doc.text:
加州葡萄酒历史

加州葡萄酒的历史可追溯至18世纪中叶,以下是详细介绍：

1. 早期探索与传教士引入
• 欧洲人首次接触：1769年，西班牙传教士胡尼佩罗·塞拉神父在圣地亚哥建立了第一个传教站，开启了欧洲人在加州的殖民历史,也为葡萄种植的引入创造了契机。
• 葡萄品种的早期引入：传教士们带来了使命葡萄（Mission Grape），这是一种起源于西班牙的葡萄品种，适应加州的气候和土壤条件,成为早期加州葡萄酒产业的基础。
2. 19世纪的发展与变革
• 淘金热与葡萄酒产业的扩张：1848年的淘金热吸引了大量移民涌入加州，其中一些人带来了葡萄种植的经验和知识,促进了葡萄园面积的扩大。
• 葡萄酒酿造技术的进步：随着欧洲酿酒师的到来，加州葡萄酒产业开始采用更先进的酿造技术,葡萄酒的品质得到了显著提升。
3. 20世纪的挑战与复兴
• 禁酒令的冲击：1920年至1933年的禁酒令对加州葡萄酒产业造成了巨大打击，许多葡萄园被荒废,酿酒厂关闭。
• 产业的复兴：禁酒令结束后，加州葡萄酒产业逐渐恢复，新的葡萄品种如赤霞珠、霞多丽等被引入,葡萄酒的风格和品质更加多样化。
4. 现代加州葡萄酒产业
• 产区的多样化发展：加州拥有多个葡萄酒产区，如纳帕谷、索诺玛谷、俄罗斯河谷等，每个产区都有其独特的气候和土壤条件，适合种植不同的葡萄品种,生产出各具特色的葡萄酒。
• 品质与声誉的提升：通过不断改进种植和酿造技术，加州葡萄酒在国际上的声誉日益提高,成为全球葡萄酒市场的重要力量。

加州是全球最大的葡萄酒生产地区之一，其葡萄酒产业对加州的经济和文化发展都具有重要意义。

doc.text:
01
酒店加利福尼亚的魅力
△ 老鹰乐队与经典之作 
《Hotel California》，这首由美国摇滚乐坛传奇乐队 Eagles（老鹰乐队）创作的经典之作 ，被誉为“加州旅馆”，其魅力何在，让人难以抗拒。
打开百度APP畅享高清图片
老鹰乐队，这支 成立于1970年代初的美国洛杉矶摇滚乐队 ，其经典之作《Hotel California》一直被乐迷们传颂至今。尤其是现场版，更是让无数人沉醉其中，尤其是开头的 吉他solo，更是让人百听不厌 。这首歌不仅旋律动人，更在歌词中蕴含着深深的诡异韵味，寥寥数笔便道尽了上世纪70年代人们的忧伤与迷惘。
△ 歌词中的情感与主题 
此次分享，我们将深入剖析这首歌中的 迷茫、无奈与绝望的韵味 。让我们一起跟随 歌词，感受那份在黑暗中寻找光明的旅程 。在昏黑的荒漠公路上，凉风吹过发梢，空气中弥漫着温馨的大麻香。远方微弱的灯光诱人前行，但沉重的头颅和模糊的视线又让人不得不驻足。在夜幕下， 一位神秘女子出现在门口，她点燃了蜡烛，引领着前行的路 。走廊里传来阵阵说话声，这里究竟是天堂还是地狱？让我们一同探寻答案。
I thought I heard them say, 
"Welcome to the hotel California," 
Such a lovely place, 
Such a lovely face. 
Plenty of room at the hotel California, 
Any time of year, you can find it here. 
02
94年不插电现场实录
• 94年不插电现场实录 •
该MV时长7分15秒，建议您在Wi-Fi环境下欣赏，以获得最佳观看体验。此次 94年不插电现场实录的MV，记录了一场别开生面的音乐盛宴 。它不仅展示了艺术家们的 精湛技艺 ，更让观众们仿佛穿越时空，亲临现场感受那独特的音乐氛围。在欣赏的同时，您还可以通过中国日报网双语新闻了解更多相关信息，感受音乐与新闻的 完美结合 。

doc.title: 加州干红葡萄酒的未来展望：创新与挑战
doc.text:
加州干红葡萄酒的未来展望：创新与挑战

2024-07-31 06:37

加州干红葡萄酒作为美国葡萄酒产业的代表，不仅在全球市场上享有盛誉，也面临着新的发展机遇与挑战。本文将深入分析加州干红葡萄酒行业的未来展望，探讨创新与挑战如何推动行业的持续发展。

一、加州干红葡萄酒行业的创新趋势

1. 葡萄种植技术的创新：提高产量与质量

2. 酿造工艺的革新：多样化与个性化

3. 包装设计的创新：环保与时尚

4. 营销策略的创新：数字化与社交媒体

二、加州干红葡萄酒行业面临的挑战

1. 气候变化对葡萄种植的影响

2. 市场竞争加剧：新世界产区的崛起

3. 消费者口味变化：年轻化与个性化

4. 贸易壁垒与政策变动

三、加州干红葡萄酒行业的可持续发展

1. 绿色种植与有机酿造

2. 降低碳足迹：环保包装与物流

3. 社会责任：关注员工福利与社区发展

4. 教育与培训：提升消费者品酒知识

四、结语

加州干红葡萄酒行业在未来的发展中，创新与挑战将并存。通过不断的技术革新、市场拓展、环保努力和教育普及，加州干红葡萄酒行业有望实现可持续增长，为消费者带来更加丰富和多元的葡萄酒体验。随着全球葡萄酒文化的交流与融合，加州干红葡萄酒将继续作为文化交流的桥梁，连接世界各地的葡萄酒爱好者。

doc.title: 一课学透 分布式事务框架 Alibaba Seata_业务_模式_服务
doc.text:
在当今微服务架构盛行的时代，分布式事务问题已成为企业级应用开发中不可回避的挑战。Alibaba Seata作为一款开源的分布式事务解决方案，以其简单易用、高性能的特点，正在成为越来越多企业的首选。本文将带您全面了解Seata的核心概念、工作原理及应用场景，帮助您一课学透这一强大的分布式事务框架。
分布式事务的挑战
在单体应用向微服务架构演进的过程中，原本在单个数据库内通过ACID特性就能保证的事务一致性，现在需要跨越多个独立的服务和数据源。这种情况下，如何保证多个服务之间的数据一致性，成为了分布式系统设计的核心难题。
传统的分布式事务解决方案如两阶段提交(2PC)、三阶段提交(3PC)等，虽然能够保证一致性，但存在性能瓶颈、单点故障等问题。而基于最终一致性的方案如TCC、Saga等，虽然提高了系统可用性，但开发复杂度较高。Seata正是在这样的背景下应运而生，旨在提供一种既保证一致性又兼顾性能的分布式事务解决方案。
Seata核心概念
Seata的设计理念是"对业务无侵入"，让开发者能够像使用本地事务一样使用分布式事务。要理解Seata，首先需要掌握以下几个核心概念：
1. 事务协调者(TC, Transaction Coordinator)
TC是Seata架构中的核心组件，负责维护全局事务和分支事务的状态，协调全局事务的提交或回滚。TC是一个独立部署的服务，可以集群化部署以保证高可用性。
2. 事务管理器(TM, Transaction Manager)
TM定义全局事务的范围，开始全局事务、提交或回滚全局事务。TM通常集成在业务应用的调用方，由开发者通过编程方式或注解方式使用。
3. 资源管理器(RM, Resource Manager)
RM管理分支事务，与TC通信注册分支事务、报告分支事务状态，并驱动分支事务的提交或回滚。RM通常集成在业务应用的被调用方，与数据源紧密关联。
4. 全局事务ID(XID)
XID是全局事务的唯一标识，贯穿整个分布式事务的调用链，用于将不同服务中的分支事务关联到同一个全局事务中。
Seata的工作模式
Seata提供了多种事务模式以适应不同的业务场景，其中最核心的是AT模式、TCC模式、Saga模式和XA模式。
1. AT模式(Automatic Transaction)
AT模式是Seata的默认模式，也是最具特色的一种模式。它通过"自动"化的方式实现对业务的无侵入，其核心思想是基于数据源代理实现无锁自动化的事务补偿。
AT模式的工作流程分为两个阶段：
一阶段：
业务数据提交前，Seata会拦截SQL执行，解析SQL语义，获取业务数据修改前的镜像(before image)和修改后的镜像(after image) 将这些镜像数据连同分支事务信息注册到TC 提交本地事务，释放本地锁
二阶段：
如果全局事务提交，TC会通知所有分支事务异步删除镜像数据 如果全局事务回滚，TC会通知分支事务根据before image生成补偿SQL，执行回滚操作
AT模式的优势在于对业务完全无侵入，开发者只需关注业务逻辑，事务的提交和回滚由Seata自动完成。但AT模式也有局限性，它要求业务数据必须支持回滚，且隔离性依赖于数据库锁机制。
2. TCC模式(Try-Confirm-Cancel)
TCC模式是一种柔性事务解决方案，将业务操作分为Try、Confirm、Cancel三个阶段：
Try阶段：预留业务资源，检查业务可行性 Confirm阶段：确认执行业务操作，使用Try阶段预留的资源 Cancel阶段：取消业务操作，释放Try阶段预留的资源
TCC模式的优势在于性能高，不依赖数据库锁，适用于高并发场景。但缺点是开发成本高，需要为每个业务操作实现三个方法，且业务逻辑复杂。
3. Saga模式
Saga模式是一种长事务解决方案，将一个长事务拆分为多个本地事务，每个本地事务都有对应的补偿事务。如果某个本地事务失败，则按照相反顺序执行前面已成功本地事务的补偿事务。
Saga模式适用于业务流程长、涉及服务多的场景，如订单处理、供应链管理等。其优势是可以长时间运行的事务，不锁定资源。但缺点是隔离性差，需要处理补偿事务的幂等问题。
4. XA模式
XA模式是基于XA协议的分布式事务解决方案，遵循两阶段提交协议。Seata的XA模式与传统的XA协议类似，但做了一些优化，如读写分离支持、自动故障恢复等。
XA模式的优势是强一致性，适用于对一致性要求极高的场景。但缺点是性能较低，锁定资源时间长，可用性较差。
Seata的架构与部署
Seata的架构设计采用了模块化思想，主要包含以下几个部分：
1. 服务端(Server)
Seata Server即TC组件，负责全局事务协调。它支持多种存储模式：
file模式：默认模式，将事务状态信息存储在本地文件中，适用于单机测试环境 db模式：将事务状态信息存储在数据库中，适用于生产环境 redis模式：将事务状态信息存储在Redis中，适用于高性能场景
Seata Server支持集群部署，通过注册中心(如Nacos、Eureka)实现服务发现，通过配置中心(如Nacos、Apollo)实现动态配置。
2. 客户端(Client)
Seata Client包括TM和RM组件，集成在业务应用中。客户端通过以下方式与Seata Server交互：
注册分支事务：RM在执行业务数据操作前，向TC注册分支事务 报告事务状态：RM在业务操作完成后，向TC报告分支事务状态 接收协调指令：RM接收TC的提交或回滚指令，执行相应操作
Seata客户端支持多种集成方式，包括Spring Boot、Spring Cloud、Dubbo等主流框架，开发者可以通过简单的配置或注解即可使用。
Seata的应用场景
Seata适用于各种需要分布式事务的场景，特别是在以下情况下表现突出：
1. 微服务架构下的数据一致性
在微服务架构中，一个业务操作通常涉及多个服务，如电商系统的下单操作可能涉及订单服务、库存服务、支付服务等。Seata可以确保这些服务之间的数据一致性。
2. 跨库操作的数据一致性
当业务数据分布在多个数据库中时，如分库分表场景，Seata可以保证跨库操作的事务一致性。
3. 混合架构下的数据一致性
在传统单体应用与微服务并存的混合架构中，Seata可以桥接不同架构下的数据操作，保证整体一致性。
4. 异步消息处理的一致性
在基于消息队列的异步处理场景中，Seata可以确保消息发送与业务操作的一致性，避免消息丢失或重复消费。
Seata的最佳实践
要充分发挥Seata的优势，需要注意以下几点最佳实践：
1. 合理选择事务模式
根据业务特点选择合适的事务模式：
短事务、高并发场景优先考虑AT模式 长事务、业务流程复杂场景考虑Saga模式 对性能要求极高且能接受开发成本的场景考虑TCC模式 对一致性要求极高且能接受性能损耗的场景考虑XA模式
2. 优化事务边界
合理设计事务边界，避免大事务：
尽量缩小事务范围，只包含必要的操作 避免在事务中进行远程调用或耗时操作 考虑将大事务拆分为多个小事务
3. 处理异常情况
考虑各种异常情况的处理：
网络超时、服务宕机等故障...

doc.title: 并发控制（三）-- 并发调度的可串行性
doc.text:
计算机系统对并发事务中并发操作的调度是随机的，而不同的调度可能会产生不同的结果，那么哪个结果是正确的，哪个是不正确的呢？
 如果一个事务运行过程中没有其他事务同时运行，也就是说它没有受到其他事务的干扰，那么就可以认为该事务的运行结果是正常的或者预想的。因此将所有事务串行起来的调度策略一定是正确的调度策略。虽然以不同的顺序串行执行事务可能会产生不同的结果，但由子不会将数据库置于不一致状态，所以都是正确的。
 定义 多个事务的并发执行是正确的，当且仅当其结果与按某一次序串行地执行它们时的结果相同，我们称这种调度策略为可串行化（Serializable）的调度。
 可串行性（Serializability）是并发事务正确性的准则。按这个准则规定，一个给定的并发调度，当且仅当它是可串行化的，才认为是正确调度。
 例如，现在有两个事务，分别包含下列操作：
 事务T1：读B；A=B+1；写回A；
 事务T2：读A；B=A+1；写回B；
 假设A，B的初值均为2。按T1→T2次序执行结果为A=3，B=4；按T2→T1次序执行结果为B=3，A=4。
 图8．5给出了对这两个事务的三种不同的调度策略。
 图8.5（a）和（b）为两种不同的串行调度策略，虽然执行结果不同，但它们都是正确的调度；图8.5（c）产两个事务是交错执行的；由于其执行结果与（a），（b）的结果都不同，所以是错误的调度；图8.5（d）中两个事务也是交错执行的，其执行结果与串行调度（a）执行结果相同，所以是正确的调度。
 图8.5 http:/blog.csdn.net/sxhyniulin/article/details/9087879
 
 
 为了保证并发操作的正确性，DBMS的并发控制机制必须提供一定的手段来保证调度
 是可串行化的。
 从理论上讲，在某一事务执行时禁止其他事务执行的调度策略一定是可串行化的调度，这也是最简单的调度策略，但这种方法实际上是不可取的，这使用户不能充分共享数据库资源。目前DBMS普遍采用封锁方法实现并发操作调度的可串行性，从而保证调度的正确性。 
 两段锁（Two-Phase Locking，简称 2PL）协议就是保证并发调度可串行性的封锁协议。
 除此之外还有其他一些方法，如时标方法、乐观方法等来保证调度的正确性

doc.title: 最新，南京信息工程大学地理科学学院 苏布达教授团队在《Scientific Data》发布印度河流域高分辨率人口数据集
doc.text:
苏布达教授研究团队在《Scientific Data》上发表题为《Gridded Population Structure Datasets for the Indus River Basin under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways 2020-2100》的论文，发布了印度河流域高分辨率人口结构预估数据集的相关成果。我校博士生Haider Barira和景丞博士为共同第一作者，苏布达教授和姜彤教授为通讯作者。
图1 2020和2100年SSP1-5下印度河流域人口密度分布
 印度河流域是全球人口最为集中的流域，随着气候变化加剧和人口持续增长，流域面临日益严峻的水资源短缺、洪涝灾害及粮食安全挑战，亟需高分辨率人口数据支撑科学决策。研究团队基于多源人口分布数据和人口普查资料，采用自主研发的人口迭代模型，构建了共享社会经济路径（SSP1-5）下2020-2100年印度河流域2.5‘（约5kmX5km）分辨率人口预估数据集。区别传统社会经济数据制作方法，研究团队创新性地以格点预估单元，以流域内每个格点设定SSP1-5下的人口变化参数， 并开展长期预估，预估结果完整保留每个格点上的人口结构（年龄、性别）特征，实现了高分辨率社会经济数据制作新技术。该数据集目前已通过Science Data Bank平台(https://www.scidb.cn/)对国内外公开发布，供全球科研人员免费获取，为气候变化影响和适应、水资源管理、城市规划等领域提供科学支持。
 《Scientific Data》是Nature旗下开放获取期刊，专注于发表具有科学价值的高质量数据集及数据科学论文；JCR Q1，2023年影响因子9.8。该期刊强调数据的可重复性、开放共享和广泛适用性，涵盖生命科学、环境科学、社会科学等多学科领域，为全球研究者提供权威的数据发布平台。
论文网址：https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-05537-0
数据网址：https://cstr.cn/31253.11.sciencedb.19778.

doc.title: Analysing population dynamics of Eurasian otters(Lutra lutra)using non-invasive genetic capture-mark-recapture(CMR)pitfalls and ...
doc.text:
作者：
S Lampa ， K Henle ， R Klenke ， B Gruber
摘要：
Populations of the Eurasian otter (Lutra lutra) were tremendously depleted in Central Europe since the end of the 19th century. As a consequence, populations in Germany decreased heavily and in Western Germany otters even disappeared. This led to a gap in distribution that disconnects Eastern and Western European populations. But, since the 1990s otters are recovering in regions where they were absent for decades and otters of northeast Germany expanded their range towards west, closing the gap this way. To comprehend the current spread of the otter, we are studying the population dynamic of a wild otter population by using non-invasive microsatellite genotyping and genetic capture-mark-recapture (genetic CMR) over a sampling period of six years (2006-2012). Each year we collected between 200–460 fresh faecal samples on five consecutive days in an area of approximately 40km that comprises seven groups of ponds. The study area is located in one of the distribution core areas in Germany, in the "heath and pond landscape Upper Lusatia", in Eastern Saxony. The otter faeces serve as a non-invasive DNA source to generate an individual DNA-profile for individual identification by using microsatellite genotyping. Once individual DNA-profiles are revealed, the data can be applied to capture-mark-recapture models (CMR) to gain a reliable estimate of the population size and related quantities. Seven microsatellite markers and a sex marker were used to identify each individual and to estimate the population size by applying initially standard CMR models like the ones in programme CAPTURE or CAPWIRE. Despite using rigorous and accepted approaches to minimise genotyping errors like the creation of a consensus genotype through various repetitions and a screening approach to detect and discard low quality samples, we found that our data set still contained errors leading to an overestimation of two-fold. The reason for that is the comparably high, although conservatively calculated, genotyping error rate of 44.9%. In general, faecal samples contain low quantities of target DNA in a bacterial-enriched environment that includes PCR-inhibitors, as well as exo- and endogenous nucleases. Furthermore, DNA in faeces is likely exposed to hydrolytic, oxidative and enzymatic degradation. This applies even more for otter faeces. They are notorious for low DNA quality and quantity, resulting in high error rates and low genotyping success. Fortunately, methods were developed recently to overcome the error-proneness of faecal samples by incorporating genotyping errors into the analysis. We will present these methods and discuss what happens if genotyping errors are neglected. Furthermore, we have applied these methods to the data of the first three sampling years (2006-2008) and will discuss the precision of the population size estimations and provide insights into the dynamics of the population within these three years.

doc.title: Building patient-level predictive models
doc.text: Observational healthcare data, such as administrative claims and electronic health records, are increasingly used for clinical characterization of disease progression, quality improvement, and population-level effect estimation for medical product safety surveillance and comparative effectiveness. Advances in machine learning for large dataset analysis have led to increased interest in applying patient-level prediction on this type of data. Patient-level prediction offers the potential for medical practice to move beyond average treatment effects and to consider personalized risks as part of clinical decision-making. However, many published efforts in patient-level-prediction do not follow the model development guidelines, fail to perform extensive external validation, or provide insufficient model details that limits the ability of independent researchers to reproduce the models and perform external validation. This makes it hard to fairly evaluate the predictive performance of the models and reduces the likelihood of the model being used appropriately in clinical practice. To improve standards, several papers have been written detailing guidelines for best practices in developing and reporting prediction models. The Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model forIndividual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD) statementprovides clear recommendations for reporting prediction model development and validation and addresses some of the concerns related to transparency. However, data structure heterogeneity and inconsistent terminologies still make collaboration and model sharing difficult as different researchers are often required to write new code to extract the data from their databases and may define variables differently. In ourpaper, we propose a standardised framework for patient-level prediction that utilizes the OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) and standardized vocabularies, and describe the open-source software that we developed implementing the framework’s pipeline. The framework is the first to support existing best practice guidelines and will enable open dissemination of models that can be extensively validated across the network of OHDSI collaborators.

doc.text:
Topic 13 Information Risk and Data Quality Management
1.Poor data quality:
⑴financial impacts:
lower revenues,higher expenses,lower cash flows

⑵confidence-based impacts:
①incorrect business decisions
②poor forecasting
③inaccurate internal reporting

⑶satisfaction impacts:
①customers dissatisfied:
business processes faulty data
②employees dissatisfied:
unable to properly perform their job

⑷productivity impacts:
①reducing production output
②delays or increases in processing time

⑸risk impacts:
underestimating credit risks or investment risk

⑹compliance impacts:
may no longer be in compliance with regulations

2.Data errors:
⑴the most common data issues:
①data entry errors
②missing data
③duplicate records
④inconsistent data
⑤nonstandard formats
⑥complex data transformation
⑦failed identity management process
⑧undocumented,incorrect,or misleading metadata

⑵the data errors impacts:
Such data errors may lead to inconsistent reporting,incorrect product pricing,and failures in trade settlement.

3.Acceptable data:
⑴accuracy:
Data correctly reflects the real world object.

⑵completeness:
①To the extent to which the expected attributes of data are provided.
②Although data may be complete,it may not necessarily be accurate.

⑶consistency:
reasonable comparison of values between multiple data sets:
①Consistency does not necessarily imply accuracy.
②There are three types of consistency:
A.record level:
Consistency between data sets within the same record.
B.cross-record level:
Consistency between data sets in different record.
C.temporal level:
Consistency between data sets within the same record at different points in time.

⑷reasonableness:
conformity with consistency expectations
⑸currency:
the lifespan of data

⑹uniqueness:
There can only be one data item within the data set.

4.Operational data governance:
⑴definition:
It refers to the collective se of rules and process regarding data that allow an organization to have sufficient confidence in the quality of its data.

⑵data quality inspection:
It is an on-going set of steps aimed to:
①reduce the number of errors to a tolerable level
②spot data flaws and make appropriate adjustments to data
③solve the cause of the errors and flaws in a timely manner

⑶data validation:
It is a one-time step that reviews and assess whether data confirms to defined business specification.
5.Data quality scorecard:
⑴It is including base-level metric and complex metric.

⑵complex metric scorecard viewpoints:
①data quality issues view:
Considering the impact of a specific data quality problem over multiple business processes.
②business process view:
For each business process,the scorecard has complex metrics that quantify the impact of each data quality problem.
③business impact view:
The scorecard provides a high-level understanding of the risks embedded in data quality problems.

doc.text: The Silk Road is the most well-known trade route in ancient China. It got its name because silk comprised a large proportion of commodities transported along this road. The Silk Road started at Chang'an and extended as far as countries like India and Rome. The Silk Road was opened up during the Han Dynasty and reached its peak in the Tang Dynasty, with camels being the major means of transportation. Great inventions in China, such as paper-making and printing were spread to the Western world along this road and religions like Buddhism were also introduced to China. The Silk Road was not only an ancient international trade route, but also a cultural bridge linking with Africa and Europe.

doc.title: How many displays can be connected to MacBook Pro
doc.text:
How many displays can be connected to MacBook Pro

The number of external displays that you can use at the same time depends on your Mac model and the resolution and refresh rate of each display.

MacBook Pro with M4 chip and M4 Pro chip
MacBook Pro with M4 Max chip
MacBook Pro with M3 chip
MacBook Pro with M2 Pro or M3 Pro chip
MacBook Pro with M2 Max or M3 Max chip
Other MacBook Pro models
Using a supported hub or daisy-chaining displays can enable up to 2 displays over a single Thunderbolt port, but does not increase the maximum number of displays that you can connect. Connect the display with the highest resolution first.

MacBook Pro with M4 chip or M4 Pro chip

MacBook Pro models with the M4 chip or M4 Pro chip support up to two external displays simultaneously with the built-in display, based on the resolution and refresh rate of each external display. Closing the lid of your MacBook Pro with M4 chip or M4 Pro chip will not increase the number of external displays that can be supported.

One external display

Supports one display in the following configuration:

 • One display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240 Hz over Thunderbolt or HDMI

Two external displays

Supports two displays in the following configuration:

 • Two displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 144Hz over Thunderbolt or HDMI

MacBook Pro with M4 Max chip

MacBook Pro models with the M4 Max chip support up to four external displays simultaneously with the built-in display, based on the resolution and refresh rate of each external display. Closing the lid of your MacBook Pro with M4 Max chip will not increase the number of external displays that can be supported.

One external display

Supports one external display in the following configuration:

 • One display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over Thunderbolt or HDMI

Two external displays

Supports two displays in the following configuration:

 • Two displays up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over Thunderbolt or HDMI

Three external displays

Supports three external displays in any one of these configurations:

 • Two displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 144Hz, and one display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over Thunderbolt or HDMI

Four external displays

Supports four external displays in any of these configurations:

 • Four displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 144Hz over Thunderbolt or HDMI

MacBook Pro with M3 chip

MacBook Pro models introduced in 2023 or later with the M3 chip support up to two external displays simultaneously with lid closed, based on the resolution and refresh rate of each external display.

One external display

Supports one external display in the following configuration:

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • One display up to a native resolution of 4K (3840 x 2160) at 144Hz over HDMI

Two external displays

Supports two external displays in the following configuration with lid closed:

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz, and one display up to a native resolution of 5K (5120 x 2880) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt, and one display up to a native resolution of 4K (3840 x 2160) at 100Hz over HDMI

MacBook Pro with M2 Pro or M3 Pro chip

MacBook Pro models introduced in 2023 or later with the M2 Pro or M3 Pro chip support up to two external displays simultaneously, based on the resolution and refresh rate of each external display.

One external display

Supports one display in the following configuration:

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • One display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over HDMI

Two external displays

Supports two displays in the following configuration:

 • Two displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt, and one display up to a native resolution of 4K (3840 x 2160) at 144Hz over HDMI

MacBook Pro with M2 Max or M3 Max chip

MacBook Pro models introduced in 2023 or later with the M2 Max or M3 Max chip support up to four external displays simultaneously, based on the resolution and refresh rate of each external display.

One external display

Supports one external display in the following configuration:

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • One display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over HDMI

Two external displays

Supports two external displays in the following configuration:

 • Two displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • One display up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt, and one display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over HDMI

Three external displays

Supports three external displays in any one of these configurations:

 • Three displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt

 • Two displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt, and one display up to a native resolution of 8K (7680x4320) at 60Hz or 4K (3840 x 2160) at 240Hz over HDMI

Four external displays

Supports four external displays in the following configuration:

 • Three displays up to a native resolution of 6K (6144 x 3456) at 60Hz over Thunderbolt, and one display up to a native resolution of 4K (3840 x 2160) at 144Hz over HDMI

Other MacBook Pro models

Check the tech specs for your older MacBook Pro modelto find an overview of the maximum number of external displays supported, and the maximum resolution and refresh rate supported on each display.

Maximum Display Support

Available scaled resolutions for external displays in System Settings > Displays may vary by available system resources and type of connected displays. Scaled resolutions above the macOS default are not reflected in the maximum support listed above.

doc.title: Options for using Windows 11 with Mac® computers with Apple® M1 ...
doc.text:
Windows 11 runs best on a PC designed for Windows. When such an option isn't available, here are two different ways to use Windows with Mac.

Windows 11 and Windows 365 Cloud PCs

You can securely stream your full, personalized Windows 11 experience to many devices, including Mac computers built with M-series processors, on a Cloud PC through our Windows 365 service. Windows 365 is a software-as-a-service solution for organizations of all sizes, offered on a per-user, per-month basis. There are a variety of pricing options and Cloud PC configurationsavailable based on performance needs.

Windows 365 supports nested virtualization for testing, running emulators, ensuring full application compatibility, and more. For more information about setting up virtualization-based workloads, see Windows 365.

Windows 11 and Parallels Desktop

Parallels® Desktop versions 18, 19, and 20 are authorized solutions for running Arm® versions of Windows 11 Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise in a virtual environment on its platform on Apple M1, M2, and M3 computers.

The Arm version of Windows 11 has limitations that can impact your ability to use various types of hardware, games, and apps, including those that rely on DirectX 12, a suite of multimedia technologies frequently used in Windows games and other apps. For more information, see the Windows Arm-based PCs FAQ.

Experiences that depend on an additional layer of virtualization (nested virtualization) aren't supported, including:

32-bit Arm apps available from the Store in Windows aren't supported by Mac computers with M1, M2, and M3 chips. 32-bit Arm apps are in the process of being deprecated for all Arm versions of Windows. The preferred customer experience is to run 64-bit Arm apps, but you can also use apps in x64 or x86 emulation on Mac M1, M2, and M3 computers.

Note: You need to have a separate license for Windows 11 Pro if you don't already have one. A unique license is required for each instance of Windows 11 Pro, either on hardware or in a virtual machine. You can buy a license through the Download option from the Microsoft storeor purchase one through retail. Windows 11 Pro product keys are platform agnostic (x64 vs Arm). To use Windows 11 Enterprise with this solution, you first need to get the Windows 11 Pro license. Then upgrade to Windows 11 Enterprise through a volume licensing agreement (contact your IT admin for more information).

Apple, Apple M1, Apple M2, and Apple M3 and Mac are trademarks of Apple Inc.

Parallels is a registered trademark of Parallels International GmbH.

How can I run Windows 11 on MacBook Pro M4

Boot Camp doesn't work anymore.

MacBook Pro 14″, macOS 15.1

Posted on Nov 11, 2024 8:48 AM

Question marked as Top-ranking reply

Posted on Nov 11, 2024 9:02 AM

Per Microsoft: “Windows 11 runs best on a PC designed for Windows. When such an option isn't available, here are two different ways to use Windows with Mac.” This from the official support info:

https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/options-for-using-windows-11-with-mac-computers-with-apple-m1-m2-and-m3-chips-cd15fd62-9b34-4b78-b0bc-121baa3c568c
Whether Microsoft and your preferred virtual machine vendor are both supporting M4 yet, you’ll want to ask them.

Another potential option is to host Microsoft Windows somewhere (such as Azure), and access that.

Nov 11, 2024 9:02 AM in response to diethelm289 
Per Microsoft: “Windows 11 runs best on a PC designed for Windows. When such an option isn't available, here are two different ways to use Windows with Mac.” This from the official support info:

https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/options-for-using-windows-11-with-mac-computers-with-apple-m1-m2-and-m3-chips-cd15fd62-9b34-4b78-b0bc-121baa3c568c

Another potential option is to host Microsoft Windows somewhere (such as Azure), and access that.

Nov 11, 2024 1:09 PM in response to diethelm289 
You can't run regular Intel versions of Windows on an Apple Silicon Mac. Apple Silicon processors speak a different machine language than Intel and AMD ones. Thus you need to run Windows 11 for ARM. That version can run some off-the-shelf Intel applications using Intel emulation, but there are limitations, and there is overhead.

In addition, neither Apple nor Microsoft support installing Windows for ARM as a dual-boot OS on a Mac. You must run it inside an ARM virtual machine created by a program like Parallels Desktop.

So if you are running Intel applications, you will have the overhead of running them using Intel emulation/translation inside of a copy of Windows that itself is subject to the overhead of running within a virtual machine.

Nov 17, 2024 6:00 AM in response to AmericApple 
Parallels Desktop and VMware Fusion Pro appear to support DirectX 11 – but not the current version of DirectX, DirectX 12 Ultimate. Parallels Desktop supports OpenGL 4.1; VMware Fusion Pro supports "emulated" OpenGL 4.2.

Parallels Desktop – Games
Parallels – Limitations of running Windows 11 on Apple silicon Mac computers in Parallels Desktop for Mac
VMware (by Broadcom) – VMware Desktop Hypervisor
The UTM site says

"Can I run games?

No, probably not. UTM does not currently support GPU emulation/virtualization on Windows and therefore lacks support for 3D acceleration (e.g. OpenGL and DirectX). You may be able to run older games with software rendering options, but nothing with hardware acceleration."

Dec 19, 2024 5:49 PM in response to AmericApple 
It's not entirely that simple. Performance wise, you will probably be OK, but you may not have the latest DirectX or OpenGL support, as others have pointed out. If the games you want to play are a couple of years old and not too resource intensive compared to the resources you allocate to the VM (which are always less than bare metal - because your computer still needs RAM, etc) you might actually be pretty good. I think I actually played Star Wars: The Force Unleashed in a Parallels VM a year or two ago.

Brand new games that demand the latest GPU drivers and all your computer's RAM……it's a toss-up at best.

The fact remains, the best machine for playing the newest Windows games with all their graphics bells and whistles - is a dedicated Windows gaming computer like an Asus Republic of Gamers rig, or the equivalent from Acer, Dell, Razer or a similar competitor.

Nov 17, 2024 3:34 AM in response to AmericApple 
hard to say, rule of thumb is that virtual machines does not usually support much hardware 3d features compared to running on the pure "metal" so to speak

and plus then if the windows games you would be running are intel x86 based games then the windows 11 for arm CPU would need to translate the x86 code to arm instructions

so there are 2 things working against high performance 3d windows games on your m4 mac

doc.title: Limitations while using Windows Information Protection (WIP)-Microsoft
doc.text:
Applies to:
Windows 10 Windows 11
This following list provides info about the most common problems you might encounter while running Windows Information Protection in your organization.
Limitation : Your enterprise data on USB drives might be tied to the device it was protected on, based on your Azure RMS configuration.
How it appears :
If you're using Azure RMS: Authenticated users can open enterprise data on USB drives, on computers running Windows 10, version 1703. If you're not using Azure RMS: Data in the new location remains encrypted, but becomes inaccessible on other devices and for other users. For example, the file won't open or the file opens, but doesn't contain readable text.
Workaround : Share files with fellow employees through enterprise file servers or enterprise cloud locations. If data must be shared via USB, employees can decrypt protected files, but it will be audited.
We strongly recommend educating employees about how to limit or eliminate the need for this decryption.
Limitation : Direct Access is incompatible with Windows Information Protection.
How it appears : Direct Access might experience problems with how Windows Information Protection enforces app behavior and data movement because of how WIP determines what is and isn't a corporate network resource.
Workaround : We recommend that you use VPN for client access to your intranet resources.
 备注
VPN is optional and isn't required by Windows Information Protection.
Limitation :  NetworkIsolation  Group Policy setting takes precedence over MDM Policy settings.
How it appears : The  NetworkIsolation  Group Policy setting can configure network settings that can also be configured by using MDM. WIP relies on these policies being correctly configured. Workaround : If you use both Group Policy and MDM to configure your  NetworkIsolation  settings, you must make sure that those same settings are deployed to your organization using both Group Policy and MDM.
Limitation : Cortana can potentially allow data leakage if it's on the allowed apps list.
How it appears : If Cortana is on the allowed list, some files might become unexpectedly encrypted after an employee performs a search using Cortana. Your employees will still be able to use Cortana to search and provide results on enterprise documents and locations, but results might be sent to Microsoft.
Workaround : We don't recommend adding Cortana to your allowed apps list. However, if you wish to use Cortana and don't mind whether the results potentially go to Microsoft, you can make Cortana an Exempt app.
Limitation : Windows Information Protection is designed for use by a single user per device.
How it appears : A secondary user on a device might experience app compatibility issues when unenlightened apps start to automatically encrypt for all users. Additionally, only the initial, enrolled user's content can be revoked during the unenrollment process. Workaround : Have only one user per managed device. If this scenario occurs, ...

doc.title: about_Remote_Troubleshooting-Microsoft
doc.text:
Short description
Describes how to troubleshoot remote operations in PowerShell.
Long description
Before using PowerShell remoting, see  about_Remote  and  about_Remote_Requirements  for guidance on configuration and basic use.
You must have administrative rights to view or change settings for the local computer in the  WSMan:  drive. This includes changes to session configuration, trusted hosts, ports, or listeners.
You must run PowerShell with the  Run as administrator  option.
How to run as administrator
For error:
ERROR: Access is denied. You need to run this cmdlet from an elevated process.
To start Windows PowerShell with the  Run as administrator  option, right-click on the PowerShell icon in the Start Menu and select  Run as administrator .
How to enable remoting
For errors:
ERROR: ACCESS IS DENIED ERROR: The connection to the remote host was refused. Verify that the WS-Management service is running on the remote host and configured to listen for requests on the correct port and HTTP URL.
To receive remote commands, PowerShell remoting must be enabled on the computer. Windows PowerShell remoting is enabled by default on Windows Server 2012 and newer releases of Windows Server. You can run  Enable-PSRemoting  to re-enable remoting if it was disabled. For more information, see  Enable-PSRemoting .
How to enable remoting in an enterprise
For errors:
ERROR: ACCESS IS DENIED ERROR: The connection to the remote host was refused. Verify that the WS-Management service is running on the remote host and configured to listen for requests on the correct port and HTTP URL.
To enable a single computer to receive remote PowerShell commands and accept connections, use the  Enable-PSRemoting  cmdlet.
To enable remoting for multiple computers in an enterprise, you can use the following scaled options.
Enable the  Allow automatic configuration of listeners  group policy to configure listeners for remoting. Configure and enable the  Windows Firewall: Allow Local Port Exceptions  group policy. Set the startup type of the WinRM service to  Automatic  and start the service.
How to enable listeners by using a group policy
For errors:
ERROR: ACCESS IS DENIED ERROR: The connection to the remote host was refused. Verify that the WS-Management service is running on the remote host and configured to listen for requests on the correct port and HTTP URL.
Enable the  Allow automatic configuration of listeners  policy to configure the listeners for all computers in a domain.
The policy is found in the following Group Policy path:
Copy
Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components     \Windows Remote Management (WinRM)\WinRM service 
Enable the policy and specify the IPv4 and IPv6 filters. Wildcards ( * ) are permitted.
How to enable remoting on public networks
Enable-PSRemoting  returns this error when the local network is public and the  SkipNetworkProfileCheck  parameter is not used in the command.
ERROR: Unable to check the status of the firewall
...

doc.title: 苹果装上Windows MacBook Pro本本评测
doc.text: 苹果装上Windows MacBook Pro本本评测|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|http:/www.sina.com.cn 2006年04月21日 11:23 IT168.com|作者：IT168 Roosevelt（编译） IT168 编译评测译者注：MacBook Pro系列是苹果第一款采用Intel处理器的笔记本电脑。不过，装上Intel处理器的MacBook Pro仍然不能直接安装微软的Windows操作系统，用户只能采用Virtual PC软件来虚拟安装Windows操作系统。最近苹果正式推出了一款类似Virtual PC的软件Boot Camp，而这款软件的最大特点就是提供了非常完备的驱动程序，使我们可以在Windows操作系统（比如Windows XP）下面测试苹果的笔记本电脑。一直以来，由于采用不同的操作系统以及缺乏驱动程序，我们无法横向的对比苹果的笔记本电脑与其他的笔记本电脑。而如今，凭借苹果的这款Boot Camp软件，我们可以弥补这个遗憾了，下面就来看看苹果的MacBook Pro的性能到底如何。 MacBook Pro不仅是苹果最新的一款笔记本电脑，还是苹果第一款采用Intel最新双核处理器的机型。在MacBook Pro上，几乎集中了最新的笔记本电脑技术，配置强大，并且在造型、整机重量以及电池使用时间等方面做到了平衡。 这款MacBook Pro采用了如下的配置： 处理器：Intel 酷睿双核处理器 T2500，2.0GHz 产品设计和构造在产品设计以及构造方面，MacBook Pro毫无疑问是最棒的。虽然Dell、HP、Compaq的笔记本电脑如今在品质方面有了巨大的进步，但对于使用这些笔记本电脑的用户来说，苹果的笔记本电脑仍然他们十分羡慕的对象。 MacBook Pro系列保持了苹果一贯的优雅、简约的风格，让人赏心悦目。更多的就不用说了，下面就以图片说话。 即使一个小小的电源适配器，都被苹果做得那么的精致。 为了让机身的厚度削减到1英寸，MacBook Pro被迫做出了一些妥协。第一个妥协的地方就是光驱，将支持双层刻录技术的8×DVD刻录光驱换成了更薄的只支持单层刻录的4×DVD刻录光驱，而后者比前者要薄3mm。这可能会给某些用户带来不便，不过对于笔者来说，由于很少在笔记本电脑上刻录DVD光盘，因此影响不大。 MacBook Pro采用了高强度的铝合金材料，并且还有类似ThinkPad ASP的硬盘保护技术，通过在硬盘上设置一个传感器，当监测到笔记本电脑突然移动时，比如不慎掉到地上，系统会自动关闭硬盘以防止数据的丢失。一些用户甚至还开发了一款名为iAlert的软件，可以保护你的笔记本电脑以免被别人偷走。当有人试图偷走你的笔记本电脑时，这款iAlert软件会让笔记本电脑报警，并且本本的液晶屏还会随之不断闪烁，十分有趣也十分有效，特别是对那些喜欢把笔记本电脑留在图书馆或者咖啡厅而去上洗手间的用户。 尽管如此，MacBook Pro在构造上也并非尽善尽美，还是存在一些小问题，比如液晶屏有一点小小的弯曲变形。不过，MacBook Pro给你的感觉是比以前的大多数产品更加精致，有点类似于最新的iPod与第一代iPod有天壤之别。 液晶屏、摄像头和扬声器为了给高品质的iSight摄像头腾出空间，MacBook Pro的设计师将液晶屏垂直方面上的减少了60像素。这样一来，MacBook Pro液晶屏的分辨率只有1440×900，屏幕比例为16：10。虽然没有达到DVD影片以及HDTV的16：9画面比例，不过对用户的影响来说并不大，更何况这多出来的iSight摄像头效果非常不错，我认为这是一个非常公平的交易。而MacBook Pro的分辨率明显比华硕的W3J好，后者只有1280×768。 MacBook Pro液晶屏在水平方向上的可视角度显得有点变态，几乎达到了180度，但从这个角度我们还能从液晶屏上看到什么呢？而垂直方向上的可视角度可没那么好，只要偏离15度，就会出现亮度减弱的现象，如果偏得更远，那么偏色现象非常严重，整个屏幕要么变黑，要么变得很亮。 MacBook Pro上采用的液晶屏号称在亮度上比PowerBook的液晶屏亮67%，虽然没有采用流行的镜面屏，但在色彩、对比度方面足以和镜面屏相抗衡。就目前而言，这款液晶屏是我见过的笔记本电脑中最好的一块液晶屏，不仅在游戏中都没有任何的拖影现象，并且在播放从苹果网站上下载的HD高清视频时，效果也非常让人震撼。不过，当显示一片纯粹的颜色时会出现一些条纹，但这个现象不是很明显，不会给用户带来什么影响。建议大家在购买之前多去看看实际效果，对于MacBook Pro液晶屏的表现，如果10分为满分的话，我会给9.5分。 iSight 摄像头被巧妙的内置在 MacBook Pro 的显示屏上方，效果惊人。除了支持iChat 视频会议功能以外，iSight 摄像头还支持自拍，并可以为照片添加多种特效，比如下面这一张添加了Pencil特效（铅笔画）的自拍照。 MacBook Pro的扬声器被设计在键盘的左右两侧，这个位置更适合播放音乐或者电影，因为你不用担心扬声器会被什么东西挡住而影响音量，而这样的问题常常出现在那些将扬声器设计在机身前部的笔记本电脑上。MacBook Pro配置的这款扬声器仍然没有什么重音，不过作为笔记本电脑的扬声器来说，其效果已算相当不错。至于音量，完全能满足观看电影的需要。当然，如果外接一款双耳式耳机，效果会更好。性能测试以下所有的测试都是在通过Boot Camp软件安装的Windows XP操作系统下进行，所有的驱动程序都是由苹果提供。 MacBook Pro是第一款采用Intel处理器的苹果笔记本电脑，不过从最终测试的结果来看，装进MacBook Pro的这块2GHz的酷睿双核处理器，性能似乎没有达到应有的水平，但在运行Windows XP的整个过程中，MacBook Pro没有出现任何的停顿现象。 对处理器的测试主要通过Super-Pi，Super-Pi是利用计算圆周率Pi小数点后的200万位来测试处理器性能的一个程序。从结果上看，采用相同处理器的Dell Inspiron E1505的成绩比MacBook Pro快8秒，这意味着MacBook Pro存在优化的空间。当然，MacBook Pro的成绩肯定超过了Pentium M。 下面，我运行了3DMark05/06来测试显卡的性能，结果如下： 3DMark05 3DMark06 通过以上的测试，我发现MacBook Pro的显卡表现也不太正常，采用相似配置的Acer TM8204在3DMark 05下的成绩为3900，而MacBook Pro却只有2800分。经过检测后发现，问题出在MacBook Pro配置的这款ATI Mobility Radeon X1600身上，其核心频率仅为310MHz，显存也只有300MHz，远远低于ATI Mobility Radeon X1600正常的核心频率425MHz以及正常的显存频率425MHz。至于为什么苹果会降低ATI Mobility Radeon X1600的核心/显存频率，联系到后面会提到的散热，笔者猜测这么做可能是出于散热的考虑。接下来，笔者还对这块ATI Mobility Radeon X1600进行超频，发现核心频率可以超到400MHz，而显存只能超到310MHz，再高会导致系统重起。经过超频后，MacBook Pro在3DMark05的得分增长到3313，提高了18%左右。 最后是用HD Tune软件对MacBook Pro的硬盘进行测试的结果： 总的说来，虽然MacBook Pro在处理器、显卡方面没有达到应有的水平，但通过大容量的内存以及显存，多少弥补了一些不足，在性能上已经能满足大多数用户的要求。对于游戏性能，我只能这么来说，MacBook Pro运行Half-Life 2非常流畅，在游戏方面的表现与我那台采用ATI X800 PRO显卡的桌面电脑差不了多少。 由于笔者不是一位苹果的用户，因此我不能告诉大家MacBook Pro究竟比PowerBook快多少，不过在测试的整个过程中，MacBook Pro的反应速度很快，运行也非常流畅，让我满意。总之，MacBook Pro能满足那些对性能方面有高需求的用户。

As an application of the linear sieve (specialised to the ranges in (10), (11)), we will establish a famous theorem of Chen, giving (in some sense) the closest approach to the twin prime conjecture that one can hope to achieve by sieve-theoretic methods:

Theorem 5 (Chen’s theorem) There are infinitely many primes ${p}$ such that ${p+2}$ is the product of at most two primes.

The same argument gives the version of Chen’s theorem for the even Goldbach conjecture, namely that for all sufficiently large even ${N}$, there exists a prime ${p}$ between ${2}$ and ${N}$ such that ${N-p}$ is the product of at most two primes.

The discussion in these notes loosely follows that of Friedlander-Iwaniec(who study sieving problems in more general dimension than ${\kappa=1}$).

Many problems in non-multiplicative prime number theory can be recast as sieving problems. Consider for instance the problem of counting the number ${N(x)}$ of pairs of twin primes ${p,p+2}$ contained in ${[x/2,x]}$ for some large ${x}$; note that the claim that ${N(x) > 0}$ for arbitrarily large ${x}$ is equivalent to the twin prime conjecture. One can obtain this count by any of the following variants of the sieve of Eratosthenes:

1. Let ${A}$ be the set of natural numbers in ${[x/2,x-2]}$. For each prime ${p \leq \sqrt{x}$, let ${E_p}$ be the union of the residue classes ${0\ (p)}$ and ${-2\ (p)}$. Then ${N(x)}$ is the cardinality of the sifted set ${A \backslash \bigcup_{p \leq \sqrt{x} E_p}$.
2. Let ${A}$ be the set of primes in ${[x/2,x-2]}$. For each prime ${p \leq \sqrt{x}$, let ${E_p}$ be the residue class ${-2\ (p)}$. Then ${N(x)}$ is the cardinality of the sifted set ${A \backslash \bigcup_{p \leq \sqrt{x} E_p}$.
3. Let ${A}$ be the set of primes in ${[x/2+2,x]}$. For each prime ${p \leq \sqrt{x}$, let ${E_p}$ be the residue class ${2\ (p)}$. Then ${N(x)}$ is the cardinality of the sifted set ${A \backslash \bigcup_{p \leq \sqrt{x} E_p}$.
4. Let ${A}$ be the set ${\{ n(n+2): x/2 \leq n \leq x-2 \}$. For each prime ${p \leq \sqrt{x}$, let ${E_p}$ be the residue class ${0\ (p)}$ Then ${N(x)}$ is the cardinality of the sifted set ${A \backslash \bigcup_{p \leq \sqrt{x} E_p}$.

In view of these sieving interpretations of number-theoretic problems, it becomes natural to try to estimate the size of sifted sets ${A \backslash \bigcup_{p | P} E_p}$ for various finite sets ${A}$ of integers, and subsets ${E_p}$ of integers indexed by primes ${p}$ dividing some squarefree natural number ${P}$ (which, in the above examples, would be the product of all primes up to ${\sqrt{x}$). As we see in the above examples, the sets ${E_p}$ in applications are typically the union of one or more residue classes modulo ${p}$, but we will work at a more abstract level of generality here by treating ${E_p}$ as more or less arbitrary sets of integers, without caring too much about the arithmetic structure of such sets.

It turns out to be conceptually more natural to replace sets by functions, and to consider the more general the task of estimating sifted sums

$\displaystyle \sum_{n \in {\bf Z} a_n 1_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p | P} E_p} \ \ \ \ \ (1)$

for some finitely supported sequence ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ of non-negative numbers; the previous combinatorial sifting problem then corresponds to the indicator function case ${a_n=1_{n \in A}$. (One could also use other index sets here than the integers ${\bf Z}$ if desired; for much of sieve theory the index set and its subsets ${E_p}$ are treated as abstract sets, so the exact arithmetic structure of these sets is not of primary importance.)

Continuing with twin primes as a running example, we thus have the following sample sieving problem:

Problem 2 (Sieving problem for twin primes) Let ${x, z \geq 1}$, and let ${\pi_2(x,z)}$ denote the number of natural numbers ${n \leq x}$ which avoid the residue classes ${0, -2\ (p)}$ for all primes ${p < z}$. In other words, we have

$\displaystyle \pi_2(x,z) := \sum_{n \in {\bf Z} a_n 1_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p | P(z)} E_p}$

where ${a_n := 1_{n \in [1,x]}$, ${P(z) := \prod_{p < z} p}$ is the product of all the primes strictly less than ${z}$ (we omit ${z}$ itself for minor technical reasons), and ${E_p}$ is the union of the residue classes ${0, -2\ (p)}$. Obtain upper and lower bounds on ${\pi_2(x,z)}$ which are as strong as possible in the asymptotic regime where ${x}$ goes to infinity and the sifting level ${z}$ grows with ${x}$ (ideally we would like ${z}$ to grow as fast as ${\sqrt{x}$).

From the preceding discussion we know that the number of twin prime pairs ${p,p+2}$ in ${(x/2,x]}$ is equal to ${\pi_2(x-2,\sqrt{x}) - \pi_2(x/2,\sqrt{x})}$, if ${x}$ is not a perfect square; one also easily sees that the number of twin prime pairs in ${[1,x]}$ is at least ${\pi_2(x-2,\sqrt{x})}$, again if ${x}$ is not a perfect square. Thus we see that a sufficiently good answer to Problem 2would resolve the twin prime conjecture, particularly if we can get the sifting level ${z}$ to be as large as ${\sqrt{x}$.

We return now to the general problem of estimating (1). We may expand

$\displaystyle 1_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p | P} E_p} = \prod_{p | P} (1 - 1_{E_p}(n) \ \ \ \ \ (2)$

$\displaystyle = \sum_{k=0}^\infty (-1)^k \sum_{p_1 \dots p_k|P: p_1 < \dots < p_k} 1_{E_{p_1} \dots 1_{E_{p_k}(n)$

$\displaystyle = \sum_{d|P} \mu(d) 1_{E_d}(n)$

where ${E_d := \bigcap_{p|d} E_p}$ (with the convention that ${E_1={\bf Z}$). We thus arrive at the Legendre sieve identity
$\displaystyle \sum_{n \in {\bf Z} a_n 1_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p | P} E_p} = \sum_{d|P} \mu(d) \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n. \ \ \ \ \ (3)$

Specialising to the case of an indicator function ${a_n=1_{n \in A}$, we recover the inclusion-exclusion formula
$\displaystyle |A \backslash \bigcup_{p|P} E_p| = \sum_{d|P} \mu(d) |A \cap E_d|.$

Such exact sieving formulae are already satisfactory for controlling sifted sets or sifted sums when the amount of sieving is relatively small compared to the size of ${A}$. For instance, let us return to the running example in Problem 2for some ${x,z \geq 1}$. Observe that each ${E_p}$ in this example consists of ${\omega(p)}$ residue classes modulo ${p}$, where ${\omega(p)}$ is defined to equal ${1}$ when ${p=2}$ and ${2}$ when ${p}$ is odd. By the Chinese remainder theorem, this implies that for each ${d|P(z)}$, ${E_d}$ consists of ${\prod_{p|d} \omega(p)}$ residue classes modulo ${d}$. Using the basic bound

$\displaystyle \sum_{n \leq x: n = a\ (q)} 1 = \frac{x}{q} + O(1) \ \ \ \ \ (4)$

for any ${x > 0}$ and any residue class ${a\ (q)}$, we conclude that

$\displaystyle \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n = g(d) x + O( \prod_{p|d} \omega(p) ) \ \ \ \ \ (5)$

for any ${d|P(z)}$, where ${g}$ is the multiplicative function

$\displaystyle g(d) := \prod_{p|d: p|P(z)} \frac{\omega(p)}{p}.$

Since ${\omega(p) \leq 2}$ and there are at most ${\pi(z)}$ primes dividing ${P(z)}$, we may crudely bound ${\prod_{p|d} \omega(p) \leq 2^{\pi(z)}$, thus

$\displaystyle \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n = g(d) x + O( 2^{\pi(z)} ). \ \ \ \ \ (6)$

Also, the number of divisors of ${P(z)}$ is at most ${2^{\pi(z)}$. From the Legendre sieve (3), we thus conclude that

$\displaystyle \pi_2(x,z) = (\sum_{d|P(z)} \mu(d) g(d) x) + O( 4^{\pi(z)} ).$

We can factorise the main term to obtain

$\displaystyle \pi_2(x,z) = x \prod_{p < z} (1-\frac{\omega(p)}{p}) + O( 4^{\pi(z)} ).$

This is compatible with the heuristic

$\displaystyle \pi_2(x,z) \approx x \prod_{p < z} (1-\frac{\omega(p)}{p}) \ \ \ \ \ (7)$

coming from the equidistribution of residues principle (Section 3 of Supplement 4), bearing in mind (from the modified Cramér model, see Section 1 of Supplement 4) that we expect this heuristic to become inaccurate when ${z}$ becomes very large. We can simplify the right-hand side of (7)by recalling the twin prime constant
$\displaystyle \Pi_2 := \prod_{p>2} (1 - \frac{1}{(p-1)^2}) = 0.6601618\dots$

(see equation (7) from Supplement 4); note that

$\displaystyle \prod_p (1-\frac{1}{p})^{-2} (1-\frac{\omega(p)}{p}) = 2 \Pi_2$

so from Mertens’ third theorem (Theorem 42 from Notes 1) one has

$\displaystyle \prod_{p < z} (1-\frac{\omega(p)}{p}) = (2\Pi_2+o(1) \frac{1}{(e^\gamma \log z)^2} \ \ \ \ \ (8)$

as ${z \rightarrow \infty}$. Bounding ${4^{\pi(z)}$ crudely by ${\exp(o(z)}$, we conclude in particular that

$\displaystyle \pi_2(x,z) = (2\Pi_2 +o(1) \frac{x}{(e^\gamma \log z)^2}$

when ${x,z \rightarrow \infty}$ with ${z = O(\log x)}$. This is somewhat encouraging for the purposes of getting a sufficiently good answer to Problem 2to resolve the twin prime conjecture, but note that ${z}$ is currently far too small: one needs to get ${z}$ as large as ${\sqrt{x}$ before one is counting twin primes, and currently ${z}$ can only get as large as ${\log x}$.

The problem is that the number of terms in the Legendre sieve (3)basically grows exponentially in ${z}$, and so the error terms in (4)accumulate to an unacceptable extent once ${z}$ is significantly larger than ${\log x}$. An alternative way to phrase this problem is that the estimate (4)is only expected to be truly useful in the regime ${q=o(x)}$; on the other hand, the moduli ${d}$ appearing in (3)can be as large as ${P}$, which grows exponentially in ${z}$ by the prime number theorem.

To resolve this problem, it is thus natural to try to truncate the Legendre sieve, in such a way that one only uses information about the sums ${\sum_{n \in E_d} a_n}$ for a relatively small number of divisors ${d}$ of ${P}$, such as those ${d}$ which are below a certain threshold ${D}$. This leads to the following general sieving problem:

Problem 3 (General sieving problem) Let ${P}$ be a squarefree natural number, and let ${\mathcal D}$ be a set of divisors of ${P}$. For each prime ${p}$ dividing ${P}$, let ${E_p}$ be a set of integers, and define ${E_d := \bigcap_{p|d} E_p}$ for all ${d|P}$ (with the convention that ${E_1={\bf Z}$). Suppose that ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ is an (unknown) finitely supported sequence of non-negative reals, whose sums

$\displaystyle X_d := \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n \ \ \ \ \ (9)$

are known for all ${d \in {\mathcal D}$. What are the best upper and lower bounds one can conclude on the quantity (1)?

Here is a simple example of this type of problem (corresponding to the case ${P = 6}$, ${\mathcal D} = \{1, 2, 3\}$, ${X_1 = 100}$, ${X_2 = 60}$, and ${X_3 = 10}$):

Exercise 4 Let ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ be a finitely supported sequence of non-negative reals such that ${\sum_{n \in {\bf Z} a_n = 100}$, ${\sum_{n \in {\bf Z}: 2|n} a_n = 60}$, and ${\sum_{n \in {\bf Z}: 3|n} a_n = 10}$. Show that

$\displaystyle 30 \leq \sum_{n \in {\bf Z}: (n,6)=1} a_n \leq 40$

and give counterexamples to show that these bounds cannot be improved in general, even when ${a_n}$ is an indicator function sequence.

Problem 3is an example of a linear programmingproblem. By using linear programming duality(as encapsulated by results such as the Hahn-Banach theorem, the separating hyperplane theorem, or the Farkas lemma), we can rephrase the above problem in terms of upper and lower bound sieves:

Theorem 5 (Dual sieve problem) Let ${P, {\mathcal D}, E_p, E_d, X_d}$ be as in Problem 3. We assume that Problem 3is feasible, in the sense that there exists at least one finitely supported sequence ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ of non-negative reals obeying the constraints in that problem. Define an (normalised) upper bound sieve to be a function ${\nu^+: {\bf Z} \rightarrow {\bf R}$ of the form

$\displaystyle \nu^+ = \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d 1_{E_d}$

for some coefficients ${\lambda^+_d \in {\bf R}$, and obeying the pointwise lower bound

$\displaystyle \nu^+(n) \geq 1_{n \not \in\bigcup_{p|P} E_p}(n) \ \ \ \ \ (10)$

for all ${n \in {\bf Z}$ (in particular ${\nu^+}$ is non-negative). Similarly, define a (normalised) lower bound sieve to be a function ${\nu^-: {\bf Z} \rightarrow {\bf R}$ of the form

$\displaystyle \nu^-(n) = \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^-_d 1_{E_d}$

for some coefficients ${\lambda^-_d \in {\bf R}$, and obeying the pointwise upper bound

$\displaystyle \nu^-(n) \leq 1_{n \not \in\bigcup_{p|P} E_p}(n)$

for all ${n \in {\bf Z}$. Thus for instance ${1}$ and ${0}$ are (trivially) upper bound sieves and lower bound sieves respectively.

• (i) The supremal value of the quantity (1), subject to the constraints in Problem 3, is equal to the infimal value of the quantity ${\sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d X_d}$, as ${\nu^+ = \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d 1_{E_d}$ ranges over all upper bound sieves.
• (ii) The infimal value of the quantity (1), subject to the constraints in Problem 3, is equal to the supremal value of the quantity ${\sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^-_d X_d}$, as ${\nu^- = \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^-_d 1_{E_d}$ ranges over all lower bound sieves.

Proof: We prove part (i) only, and leave part (ii) as an exercise. Let ${A}$ be the supremal value of the quantity (1)given the constraints in Problem 3, and let ${B}$ be the infimal value of ${\sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d X_d}$. We need to show that ${A=B}$.

We first establish the easy inequality ${A \leq B}$. If the sequence ${a_n}$ obeys the constraints in Problem 3, and ${\nu^+ = \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d 1_{E_d}$ is an upper bound sieve, then

$\displaystyle \sum_n \nu^+(n) a_n = \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d X_d$

and hence (by the non-negativity of ${\nu^+}$ and ${a_n}$)

$\displaystyle \sum_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p|P} E_p} a_n \leq \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d X_d;$

taking suprema in ${f}$ and infima in ${\nu^+}$ we conclude that ${A \leq B}$.

Now suppose for contradiction that ${A, thus ${A < C < B}$ for some real number ${C}$. We will argue using the hyperplane separation theorem; one can also proceed using one of the other duality results mentioned above. (See this previous blog postfor some discussion of the connections between these various forms of linear duality.) Consider the affine functional

$\displaystyle \rho_0: (a_n)_{n \in{\bf Z} \mapsto C - \sum_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p|P} E_p} a_n.$

on the vector space of finitely supported sequences ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ of reals. On the one hand, since ${C > A}$, this functional is positive for every sequence ${(a_n)_{n \in{\bf Z}$ obeying the constraints in Problem 3. Next, let ${K}$ be the space of affine functionals ${\rho}$ of the form

$\displaystyle \rho: (a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z} \mapsto -\sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d ( \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n - X_d ) + \sum_n a_n \nu(n) + X$

for some real numbers ${\lambda^+_d \in {\bf R}$, some non-negative function ${\nu: {\bf Z} \rightarrow {\bf R}^+}$ which is a finite linear combination of the ${1_{E_d}$ for ${d|P}$, and some non-negative ${X}$. This is a closed convex cone in a finite-dimensional vector space ${V}$; note also that ${\rho_0}$ lies in ${V}$. Suppose first that ${\rho_0 \in K}$, thus we have a representation of the form

$\displaystyle C - \sum_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p|P} E_p} a_n = -\sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d ( \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n - X_d ) + \sum_n a_n \nu(n) + X$

for any finitely supported sequence ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$. Comparing coefficients, we conclude that

$\displaystyle \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d 1_{E_d}(n) \geq 1_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p|P} E_p}$

for any ${n}$ (i.e., ${\sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d 1_{E_d}$ is an upper bound sieve), and also

$\displaystyle C \geq \sum_{d \in {\mathcal D} \lambda^+_d X_d,$

and thus ${C \geq B}$, a contradiction. Thus ${\rho_0}$ lies outside of ${K}$. But then by the hyperplane separation theorem, we can find an affine functional ${\iota: V \rightarrow {\bf R}$ on ${V}$ that is non-negative on ${K}$ and negative on ${\rho_0}$. By duality, such an affine functional takes the form ${\iota: \rho \mapsto \rho(b_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}) + c}$ for some finitely supported sequence ${(b_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ and ${c \in {\bf R}$ (indeed, ${(b_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ can be supported on a finite set consisting of a single representative for each atom of the finite ${\sigma}$-algebra generated by the ${E_p}$). Since ${\iota}$ is non-negative on the cone ${K}$, we see (on testing against multiples of the functionals ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z} \mapsto \sum_{n \in E_d} a_n - X_d}$ or ${(a_n)_{n \in {\bf Z} \mapsto a_n}$) that the ${b_n}$ and ${c}$ are non-negative, and that ${\sum_{n \in E_d} b_n - X_d = 0}$ for all ${d \in {\mathcal D}$; thus ${(b_n)_{n \in {\bf Z}$ is feasible for Problem 3. Since ${\iota}$ is negative on ${\rho_0}$, we see that

$\displaystyle \sum_{n \not \in \bigcup_{p|P} E_p} b_n \geq C$

and thus ${A \geq C}$, giving the desired contradiction. $\Box$
